title: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine threaten air defense systems

slides.headline: Starlink restrictions in Ukraine threaten air defense systems
slides.subtitle: Throttling mobile internet disrupts critical defense operations

slides.explanation: The impact goes beyond battlefield tactics. It threatens the stability of air defense networks that protect civilian areas across the country.

slides.headline: The biggest risk is to defense, not offense
slides.explanation: While many focus on how this limits Ukraine's ability to strike oil refineries, experts warn the real danger is degrading the country's shield against air attacks.
We compared reports from six independent outlets including the BBC and Deutsche Welle. They all confirm that connection throttling poses a serious risk to defense operations.

slides.subtitle: Read the full briefing on the Headlinne app.

caption:
Ukraine is facing a new, quiet challenge as restrictions on the Starlink mobile internet system begin to take hold.

While much of the conversation focuses on offensive operations, the real concern is defensive.

Experts agree that throttling these connections will likely disrupt the air defense systems that keep Ukrainian cities safe. This adds another layer of uncertainty to an already volatile situation.

With military strategy and civilian safety so closely tied to connectivity, how do you think this shift will change the war's trajectory?
